integrity: Every candidate triple with 1<=a<b<c<504 is checked against every factor of length c+1. For every required factor length the extracted prefix has exactly the published total 2m+1 distinct factors. The exhaustive mismatch-bitset census is followed by a direct-string replay of every one of the 9352 stored survivors.
scientific_limitations: This is a finite exact classification of Tribonacci 3-pseudoperiods with largest shift below the canonical substitution length 504. It does not provide an automaton or characterize triples at or above 504. Factor-set exhaustiveness uses the published Tribonacci factor-complexity theorem p(m)=2m+1.
title: Exact Tribonacci 3-pseudoperiod census below the 504 substitution scale
